description: Soroban Address compressed into one F_r element: address_to_field(a) = Poseidon2(ADDRESS, lo, hi), where the input is the 56-character ASCII strkey (SEP-23) and lo / hi interpret its lower and upper 28 bytes respectively in LITTLE-endian byte order. Unlike every other primitive here this one is not implemented in Noir: the circuits receive addr_f as an opaque public input, so the derivation exists only in the contract (soroban-poseidon, via storage.rs::address_to_field) and in each client. That makes it the one primitive with two independent implementations and therefore the one most in need of a pinned vector. Inputs are strkeys rather than field elements; consumers must encode the string as ASCII before decomposing it. The two vectors below use the all-zero ed25519 public key and the all-zero contract id, so they are reproducible without reference to any deployment and cover both version bytes the host accepts (G = 0x30, C = 0x10).
